ننثني (form VII)
# نَنْثَنِي (nanṯanī) /nan.θa.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْثَنَى (inṯanā)
# نَنْثَنِيَ (nanṯaniya) /nan.θa.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْثَنَى (inṯanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
